name: task_spawn
description: Launch a subagent asynchronously and return its task_id immediately; spawned subtasks run concurrently. Use for independent subtasks. For a SINGLE subtask whose result you need, prefer the synchronous `task` — a lone task_spawn + task_wait adds no concurrency, only overhead. Continue parent-side work meanwhile; the task_id stays valid until its result is consumed — collect with task_wait, acknowledge with task_integrate. Top-level agent only: nested subagents error — do the work directly.

description.description: Short description of what this task will do (3-10 words).

prompt.description: The task/prompt to send to the subagent. Be specific about what you want accomplished.

agent.description: Optional subagent name (default: auto-select). Omit unless you know the exact name.

model.description: Optional model override. Default: reuse parent model; override only when the subtask is clearly lighter or heavier.

inherit.description: Pass a plain string: 'all', 'none', or a comma-separated subset of history/memory/cwd/skills. Default: cwd+skills (history/memory private) — keep it for workspace-touching steps, serial steps hand off via files; 'none' for pure analysis; 'all' only when the subtask needs the full conversation.

response_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object the subagent's single returned value must match, e.g. {"type": "string"} — not a bare type name.
